name: event-calendar
title: Event calendar
description: An Outlook-style scheduling surface with day, week, and month views: a toolbar with Today, paging, and a view switcher, a scrollable time grid with cascade-stacked event chips, an all-day shelf, a now indicator, drag or keyboard range selection with a slot for the host's own quick-create UI, and event rescheduling by drag, edge-drag resizing, or keyboard chords behind a confirmable move gate.
